resources.string: Turns MKV files into MP4s that play on Google TV and Chromecast. Video is copied as is when it can be (fast, no quality loss); audio becomes AAC; text subtitles are kept.
Max compatibility: also re-encode HEVC to H.264 and mix audio to stereo (much slower, for older TVs and dongles)
Converted files go to Movies/MKV to MP4 on this device.
